id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Point-to-point host-master / card-slave bus on a 9-pin (SD) or 4-pin (SPI) connector. Modern consumer SD / microSD slots are single-host / single-card.

supported_topologies.name: Legacy SD multi-card bus
supported_topologies.description: Historical; multiple cards with unique RCAs; rarely used today.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Generates CLK; issues all commands; controls bus mode + voltage + clock rate.
Responds to CMD; sources/sinks DAT; signals busy via DAT0.

fields.interconnect_role: There is no protocol-layer interconnect (no router / bridge). The bus is a flat 1-host : N-card bus; addressing is by RCA on CMD after CMD3.

ordering_guarantees.within_a_block: Bits transmitted MSB-first per byte on DAT.
ordering_guarantees.across_blocks: Sequential on multi-block read/write; CQ may complete tasks out-of-order.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Single linear LBA address space (byte-addressable SDSC; block-addressable SDHC/SDXC). No memory-mapped peripheral regions on the bus.
